Subject: Fwd: sudden 5xx burst during billing window impacting checkout

Forwarding initial notes from our runtime investigation. Summary: automatic prefetching path experienced aggressive KV-cache eviction (prefetch store) following a transient memory pressure on two serving shards in us-west-2. When the prefetch entries were evicted during the billing spike, tokenization re-ran and we observed repeated tokenization stalls at the model frontend which manifested as 5xx for some callers (particularly short-lived billing jobs that do not retry with backoff).

Preliminary findings and evidence: 1) kernel-level memory pressure spike at 15:03:42 PDT on shard-a (attached tracekit-eviction-snippet.txt). 2) correlated prefetched-kv miss rate increase from ~0.2% to ~12% during the 15:04-15:16 window. 3) we saw a small backlog in the tokenization pool for ~11 minutes which maps to the customer-reported window.

We are continuing log aggregation; full raw trace bundle will be uploaded to the Drive link (INFR-224). Grace, can you validate whether this should qualify under the availability SLO (we had an autoscaler event but also a prefetch eviction cascade — trying to separate operational vs platform defects)?

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

Hi Rahil — thanks for your patience while we finished the evidence aggregation. Summary of outcome: after correlating your supplied request sample with our traces, we confirm an availability impact window of 2026-05-22T15:04:00-2026-05-22T15:16:59 PDT (11m 59s). Root cause: a prefetch-KV eviction cascade triggered by a transient memory pressure + concurrent autoscaler pacing that caused tokenization retries to queue and fail for a subset of short-lived billing requests.

Entitlement: QuickCart meets the threshold for a proportional SLA credit under section 4.2 of the Agreement. We're preparing a formal credit calculation; preliminary estimate is a pro-rata credit for the impacted minute buckets (we will share the exact $ amount after final reconciliation).

Postmortem & next steps: we've created INFR-224 and a shared Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Prefetch-RCA-QuickCart) with the raw trace bundle and the rdw-logs-20260522-prefetch.tar.gz attachment. We propose a 60-minute joint postmortem on Mon, 25 May 2026 at 14:00 PDT — please confirm availability or propose an alternative.

Attachments included: tracekit-eviction-snippet.txt (extracted timeline), rdw-logs-20260522-prefetch.tar.gz (server logs), quickcart-impact-summary.csv (from your earlier message).

Laura will follow up on the credit processing timeline and any contractual paperwork. Grace and Karthik will post the finalized RCA in INFR-224.

Thanks again for the clear report — that helped us shorten the triage window.
